title: Multi-Scope Visualization
audit_note: Swimlane view fully implemented (SwimlaneView, ViewModeToggle integrated). Dependency visualization complete with gutter-based lines. DependencyIndicator now always shows circles on both sides (empty placeholders visible as subtle dots - UX improvement over spec). Missing: list-view scope grouping (uem001-002), zoom levels (uem004), add-step per-scope (uem005-006). 8/11 acceptance criteria met.

summary.goal: Visualize plans with multiple scopes showing steps grouped by scope with cross-scope dependencies
summary.context: Real work crosses boundaries. Steps group by scope (repo/team/domain). Cross-scope dependencies are AI-inferred and visually connected. Users see the whole system, not isolated tasks.

acceptance_criteria.description: Steps grouped into scope sections

Left indicator shows incoming dependencies (what step depends on)
Right indicator shows outgoing dependencies (what blocks on this step)

Lines drawn in gutters (left/right margins), never crossing over card content
Cross-scope dependencies shown with distinct color (orange/warning)
Swimlane view option showing scopes as horizontal lanes
Scope summary statistics (step count, completion %, blocked count)
Progress indicators per scope (N/M complete)
Click indicator scrolls to and highlights connected step
Zoom levels: Overview (collapsed), Expanded (1-level), Full Detail
Add step button within each scope section

steps.title: Enhance dependency line rendering
steps.description: Implement v005 dependency line visualization. Intra-scope: stroke var(--color-border) #e2e8f0, 2px width, solid, 0.6 opacity. Cross-scope: stroke var(--color-primary) #2563eb, 2px width, dasharray '6 4', 0.7 opacity. Highlighted: stroke #2563eb, 3px width, opacity 1.0, drop-shadow filter. Critical path: stroke var(--color-error) #ef4444, 2px, solid, 0.8 opacity. Path algorithms - list view: intra=vertical (source.bottom-center to target.top-center), cross=bezier (source.right-center, control1 +60px/0, control2 +60px/+dy, target.left-center). Swimlane: intra=horizontal, cross=bezier (source.bottom-center, control1 0/+40px, control2 dx/+40px, target.top-center). SVG arrowhead marker 8x8. useDependencyPositions hook returns Map<stepId, DOMRect>. Update on scroll/resize/expand with 16ms debounce.

acceptance_criteria.description: Intra-scope lines: solid, stroke #e2e8f0, 2px width, 0.6 opacity

Swimlane paths: horizontal for intra, bezier curve (+40px control points) for cross-scope
Highlighted state: 3px width, opacity 1.0, drop-shadow(0 0 3px var(--color-primary))
Critical path lines: stroke #ef4444, solid, 0.8 opacity
SVG arrowhead marker 8x8, points to dependent step
useDependencyPositions hook tracks DOM positions, updates with 16ms debounce

audit.evidence: DependencyLinesOverlay.tsx implements all line types with exact colors and path algorithms. useDependencyPositions.ts (93 lines) has 16ms debounce. Arrowhead markers 8x8 defined in SVG defs. Title elements provide tooltips.
